description: Navigate to the Reading category in GCompris and open the 'Ordering Sentences' activity (icon showing scrambled words or sentence structure). Solve the first 5 sentence puzzles by dragging the word blocks into the correct order. After solving each, the game will indicate success. Create a text file at '~/Documents/sentence_report.txt' containing the 5 sentences you solved, one per line (e.g., 'The sky is blue.'). Also, take a screenshot of the activity showing a solved sentence and save it to '~/Documents/sentence_evidence.png'.
